The '''Star Jewel Guard''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of six [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] that served as a part of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]{{'s}} [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]]. Six of the squadron's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were stationed aboard&mdash;and acted as escort to&mdash;Jabba's personal space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']].<ref name="Star Jewel Guard" />
